## Izzy Moonbow — Generation 5

![Izzy Moonbow — Hasbro promotional artwork](https://assets-us-01.kc-usercontent.com/500e0a65-283d-00ef-33b2-7f1f20488fe2/1e4de962-f94c-46ea-928a-1f3a353156bb/Izzy%20Moonbow.png)

**Who she is:** Izzy is the buoyant, glitter-loving unicorn from Bridlewood who wanders into unicorn-fearing Maretime Bay and befriends Sunny Starscout in *My Little Pony: A New Generation* (2021). She loves turning discarded objects into crafts, calling it **“uni-cycling.”** The meeting helps set the quest to reunite Equestria’s divided pony kinds in motion. [Netflix’s film synopsis](https://media.netflix.com/en/only-on-netflix/81424207) · [Hasbro character merchandise description](https://consumercare.hasbro.com/en-us/product/my-little-pony-a-new-generation-movie-story-scenes-critter-creation-izzy-moonbow-25-accessories-and-pony-toy/3EE54E5F-6328-45C6-BD22-880C5AC6E881)

**Spot her:** Lilac-purple coat; enormous curly blue mane and tail, sometimes fading toward violet; pink-magenta eyes; pale spiral horn; multicolored friendship bracelet; and a **blue heart/button cutie mark with sewing pins**. Her 2D *Tell Your Tale* look is puffier and more stylized.

**Names and disguises:** *+Izzy Moonbow** is her *official* name, public in the February 2021 G5 reveal—not a fandom-assigned name. “Iz” is a short nickname. Artist **Lea Dabssi (Imalou)** worked on Izzy’s original design. Some fandom histories give her early production label as **“The Caregiver”**; the original production note was not independently verified, so that is *not* an on-screen alias. Her **actual secret street-art identity is Sneaksy**, a hooded persona she adopts in *Tell Your Tale*’s “Sneaksy Strikes Again” (2022). **“Izzy Does It”** names her mobile crafting cart, not a separate pony. [Early name reporting](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2021/02/the-mlp-generation-5-pony-names-are.html) · [Dabssi’s portfolio](https://imalou.artstation.com/projects/dLJ8v3) · [Production-label account](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Izzy_Moonbow) · [Sneaksy episode transcript](https://g5mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Sneaksy_Strikes_Again/Transcript)

**Speaks and sings:** **Kimiko Glenn** voices her in the 2021 film; **Ana Sani** voices her in *Make Your Mark* and *Tell Your Tale*. Notable appearances include *Make Your Mark*’s “Izzy Does It” and “The Traditional Unicorn Sleep-Over,” plus the licensed **IDW G5 comics** beginning in 2022. Those comics are an official licensed adaptation/continuation, not a fan-created identity. [Series voice listing](https://g5mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Cast) · [2022 comic announcement](https://comic-watch.com/news/news-watch-idw-is-launching-a-new-generation-of-my-little-pony-comics)
